name: Ahmad bin Hassan
bio:
Ahmad’s motorsport journey began with a childhood fascination for go-karts, evolving into a passion for engineering after building his own kart from spare parts. He earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering and quickly found his niche in racing. Before joining MP Motorsport Junior, Ahmad spent several years with a smaller Formula 4 team, where he honed his skills in data analysis and vehicle dynamics. He is known for his meticulous approach to problem-solving and his ability to quickly adapt to changing track conditions.

Ahmad believes that the key to success is fostering a collaborative environment where engineers can freely share ideas and learn from each other. He focuses on optimizing existing systems and incrementally improving performance rather than chasing radical changes. He is distinctive for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to clearly communicate complex technical issues to drivers and other team members. His experience in smaller teams taught him resourcefulness and the importance of making the most of available assets, a skill he brings to MP Motorsport Junior.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a lean build and often wears glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on calibrating his tools every morning before starting work.
